title: Hynek 1966 article on UFOs over Minot missiles
place_text: Minot Air Force Base, North Dakota

tellings.quote: UFOs he stumbled upon an article that famed astronomer Jay Allen HCK had written in 1966 while running Project Blue Book the official government UFO investigations program out of the Air Force the article said that UFOs had float around nuclear missiles at Min not Air Force Base in North Dakota

plain: An article written in 1966 by the well-known astronomer J. Allen Hynek is said to report UFOs floating around nuclear missiles at Minot Air Force Base in North Dakota. Michels says Hynek wrote it while running Project Blue Book, the US Air Force's official UFO study of the 1950s and 60s, and that his guest, the researcher Robert Hastings, came across it by chance. Michels tells it as the starting point of the idea that UFOs take an interest in nuclear weapons.
